technical-fit.content:
# Technical fit

## Site A — Marsh Lane Store
Vendor: V1
Constraint: design minimum -12 °C; V1 is rated to -20 °C. V2 is excluded by the 2023 marsh-lane failure.

## Site B — Harbour Workshop
Vendor: V3
Constraint: design minimum -4 °C and a coastal-rated warranty; V3 is the only vendor meeting both.

## Site C — School Annexe
Vendor: V3
Constraint: ambient minimum 2 °C and a unit no wider than 800 mm; V3 is 750 mm wide. The 2023 V2 failure was at -8 °C, below this site's minimum.

## Summary

A: V1. B: V3. C: V3.

cost-schedule.content:
# Cost and schedule

## Budget

| Site | Low (£) | High (£) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | 25,800 | 36,200 |
| B | 25,800 | 36,200 |
| C | 25,800 | 36,200 |

## Sequence

A in January–February, B in March–April, C in May–June. Order each unit before its window; the longest current lead time is 10 weeks, so the B order must be placed by late December.

## Total

Committed low: £77,400; high: £108,600. Contingency at 8%: £6,192–£8,688. Total £83,592–£117,288, within the £120,000 grant.
